Asha —

Quick note on marketplace activation + billing paths and the practical checklist you'll see in the MPA:

GCP private offer path (preferred if you want direct invoices to NovaMed):
1) NovaMed accepts private offer via link (we prepare DocuSign and acceptance packet).
2) On acceptance, NovaMed needs to add Redwood as a billing account user OR provide a billing-admin contact that can link the private offer to your billing account. We do not need full org access — just the billing-owner permission.
3) Once linked, GCP will create invoices to NovaMed under the private offer SKUs; Redwood will reconcile and issue a vendor invoice (Net30) if requested.
4) If you prefer reseller routing, provide reseller name and billing contact; activation requires a reseller mapping step which can add 3 business days.

AWS marketplace path differences: acceptance is similar, but billing often routes through AWS invoicing. That can delay Redwood's vendor invoice until AWS confirms acceptance. If time to first invoice matters, GCP direct private offer is generally faster.

Action items for NovaMed to avoid delays:
- Provide billing-admin contact (name + email) by 2029-07-30.
- Confirm reseller vs direct invoice preference by 2029-07-30.
- Legal redlines (if any) by 2029-07-31 to hit PO cutoff.

I'll prepare a one-pager that maps the exact billing tickboxes and attach it to the MPA in Drive.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Onboarding, Redwood Inference
